Alternate art and parallel rares carry the premium

In the Digimon Card Game, alternate art and parallel treatments of a card trade well above the standard run, while the card number stays the same. Box topper promos add another layer.

Card AI suggests matching records with the set and card number. Review the artwork and confirm the variant and finish before using the selected printing's price.

Promos and set cards are not interchangeable

Digimon distributes a lot of cards through tournament and box promos, and these sit in a different market from the set printings of the same character. Each is recorded as its own entry in your collection.

Raw and graded, tracked separately

Raw cards are stored with their condition, graded cards with the grading company and grade across PSA, BGS, CGC and SGC. You record the grade from the slab; Card AI does not estimate what a raw card would grade.

Digimon card scanner questions.

Can Card AI tell Digimon alternate art from the standard version?

The scan can suggest matching records, but alternate art may share a card number with the standard version. Review the artwork and confirm the correct record and finish before adding it.

Does it handle Japanese Digimon cards?

Language is tracked per card record, so Japanese and English copies are stored and priced as separate entries.

Can I scan a whole Digimon collection at once?

Bulk scanning lets you work through a stack of cards in one session and add them to your collection together.

Can I look up Digimon card values without scanning?

Yes. Search by name, set or card number to check digimon card value directly. Cards you add form a digimon collection tracker, so the total value of what you own stays current.
